translation.name: YAUBADA BONANA VEYAO IVAGUNA Bona Iduna

book.name: LOMA
book.title: Folo yana leta LOMA tovetumagana agaidiya

content: Folo yana lukafoi tovetumagana tulina tulina
agaidiya giyakahina.
Tobohiyakweyao, nuwanuwaku wanahalamanena nouda Fibi kwamayoku hagihagina. Bana tovetumagana adi yoꞋo agaidiya Senikeliya againe givetonagona.

Au mene Loma againe ginayemu-yo wanavegaꞋaulena vaita bana noumi Kaiwabu yana yoꞋo agaidiya omi yana kaliva mahamahalimiyao gilubodami amine. Kadu gava leme againe nuwanuwana wanavelugana, medema wanavelena, faꞋina iya givelugaku kadu kaliva vevine moyaꞋaidi givelugadi.
Yaku nuwakabubu Filisila wamoganedi Akwila buye, badi Yesu Keliso yana tofaisewa anafaiweya kadu iyaꞋeku.

Badi yawaidi hihawahegena be iya faꞋikuya kabisona hinaꞋalika. Nuwaku givesiule agaidiya. Keke iyaꞋekugaga, au tovetumagana adi yoꞋo moyaꞋaidi badi keke miYuda tu yoꞋo tulidiyao kalivai-dina badi agaidiya buye nuwadi givesiule.

Yaku nuwakabubu toꞋekelesiya badi adiꞋiselu yadi manuweya hivagavagaꞋauta-ma agaidiya. Yaku nuwakabubu tobohiyanuwaku Efinito againe, bana Esiya ana fafali kalivana nagona Keliso againe gimidivetumagana.
Yaku nuwakabubu bana Meli againe, bana omi hinafamiya gifaisewa toyogina.

Yaku nuwakabubu Adulonaiko kadu Yuniyasi agaidiya, badi yaku yoꞋo kalivadi boi iya badi buye deliya amiyami. Kadu badi kaliva hagihagidiyao afositolo matadiya ada badi Keliso againe himidihawahegedi tu iya muliya.
Yaku nuwakabubu Amifiliyato againe, bana tobohiyanuwaku Kaiwabu yana yoꞋo agaidiya.
Yaku nuwakabubu Ebano againe, bana Keliso yana tofaisewa anafaiweya kadu imeꞋeyao. Kadu yaku nuwakabubu tobohiyanuwaku Sitakeso againe.
Yaku nuwakabubu Afelesi againe, bana kaliva kaꞋitaluveluveni-yo yana hawahega Keliso againe au toyogina kaꞋitana. Yaku nuwakabubu Alisitobulo yana yoꞋo kalivai-dina agaidiya.
Yaku nuwakabubu Helodiyona againe bana yaku yoꞋo kalivana. Yaku nuwakabubu Nasiso yana yoꞋo gaveyao Kaiwabu againe himiyaveꞋavina-ma kalivai-dina agaidiya.

Yaku nuwakabubu Telaifina kadu Telaifosa agaidiya, badi vevine-dina Kaiwabu faꞋine hififaisewa toyogina. Yaku nuwakabubu nouku hagihagina Fesisi againe, bana kadu kwamayoku saꞋeyana Kaiwabu faꞋine gifaisewa toyogina.
Yaku nuwakabubu Lufasi againe, bana kalivai-nadi Kaiwabu ana tovetumagana hagihagi-moꞋena. Kadu yaku nuwakabubu Lufasi hinana agaidiya, badi kadu iya hihawavenatuneku.
Yaku nuwakabubu Asinikelito, Filegoni, Hemesa, Fateloba, Hemasa agaidiya kadu tobohiyadeyao badi kalivai-dina buye himimiyami-ma agaidiya.
Yaku nuwakabubu Filologo kadu Yuliya agaidiya, kadu Neleyo nouna buyeꞋi agaidiya, ada Olimufa kadu Yaubada yana kaliva yana vevine moyaꞋaidi badi buye himimiyami-ma agaidiya.
Taumiyao wanaveꞋalulusiule againe tobohiyamiyao wanaꞋatulauhidi be higa yami nuwanuwa hawahawahegana wanaseyemaunena. Keliso ana tovetumagana adi yoꞋo tulina tulina hilukafoi agaimiya.
Folo yana kivetuvetunu kadu saꞋeyana gilukahihiyena.

Tu tobohiyakweyao ganagahevagadonemi be badi vehawala tulina hihawavelevelemi-ma agaidiya wanaꞋitaveꞋavimi. Badi yadi vehawala keke vehawala Yesu Keliso yana kaliva gimidivehawalemi-ma amine, ada againe vekwageya agaimiya hivesilakahina kadu yami vetumagana hikivekoyona. Badi kalivai-dina wanamiyavehailedi.

Gaveyao medede amine hivehawala, medema keke yada Kaiwabu Keliso againe hidahawahegedi, au taudiyao wowodi ana nuwanuwa itaꞋitaluvadigana agaidiya hihawahegedi. Yadi gahe digadigagina kadu yadi bonayafayafa againe kaliva fanifanidiyao hinuwaꞋabiyedi.

Tu omiꞋiyao ma moyaꞋaidi yami dibumuhiga Kaiwabu Keliso ana vehawala againe valeyami hinogalina. Hidema faꞋina omi faꞋimiya gavemwamwala-moꞋa. Atu nuwanuwaku dewa hagihagina againe wananuwahuya tu dewa koyona wanavekwavekwavena.
Bana Yaubada aseniwalova giveleveleda-ma Setani yana faiwala ginamadudabana be omi wanavagatagona. Yada Kaiwabu Yesu yana nuwadogeya wanamiyami.
Tovetumagana Folo buye himiyami-ma yadi lukafoi.
Tu Timoti gilukafoiyemi, bana Yesu Keliso yana tofaisewa anafaiweya kadu iyaꞋeku. Kadu Lusiyo ada Yesoni ada Sosifato hilukafoiyemi, badi yaku yoꞋo kalivadi.
Iya Tetiyo hida leta Folo faꞋine gaꞋetoladina-ma yaku lukafoi Kaiwabu ana eganeya.

Kadu Gaiyasi gilukafoiyemi, bana yana manuweya iya Folo gamimiyami, ada tovetumagana adi yoꞋo matatabudi bana againe hivagavagaꞋauta-ma kalivai-nadi. Elasito bana mani koniselo hiyaudi be bana giꞋitaveꞋavina-ma kalivai-nadi kadu tobohiyada Kwato yadi lukafoi agaimiya. [
Yada Kaiwabu Yesu Keliso yana nuwadogeya moyaꞋaimi wanamiyami. Ehe hidedemi.]
Yaubada ana kailakata.

Tu Yaubada ana egana kanakilakahina. Bana anafaiweya ginafaiwalavelemi be VenuwaꞋata Yamumuna Yesu Keliso faꞋine galulumamalena-ma ana nuwanuwa amine wanahuluhuluva. Mena VenuwaꞋatai-nadi ma Yaubada yana vevai sevasevauyana gihawavemogatalena-ma ana nuwanuwa amine. Tuwai-lokalokana aituha a gavaiyehi kahegehegedi-ma agaidiya Yaubada yana vevai sevasevauyana Yesu Keliso faꞋine keke gidahawavemogataleni tu tova adamoya kabuꞋavane giyemu. E, Yaubada Tomiya-vagata givehimeya be bonana ana toꞋawatalatalaina yadi etoladi againe yana vevai sevasevauyana hihawavemogatalena, be higa yoꞋo matatabudi kalivai-dina Yaubada againe hinavetumagana be bonana hinaꞋabina.

E, Yaubada Bana anakaibe Tonuwahuya-moꞋa ma ana egana kanakilakahina ada Yesu Keliso yana faisewa faꞋina yana kaiwabu ginaduva-vagata tova inaga inaga keke ana abalauyabu. Ehe hidedemi. (Iya Folo bonaku)
